```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(base64enc)

data <- readRDS("hki-public-transport.rds")

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 14, color = "#1a1a1a")
accent_color <- "#00BCD4"

bus_data <- data |>
  filter(Vechile == "Bus") |>
  arrange(Year)

metro_data <- data |>
  filter(Vechile == "Metro") |>
  arrange(Year)

train_data <- data |>
  filter(Vechile == "Commuter train") |>
  arrange(Year)

tram_data <- data |>
  filter(Vechile == "Tram") |>
  arrange(Year)

bus_icon <- base64enc::dataURI(file = "bus-icon.png", mime = "image/png")
metro_icon <- base64enc::dataURI(file = "Metro-icon.png", mime = "image/png")
train_icon <- base64enc::dataURI(file = "Train-icon.png", mime = "image/png")
tram_icon <- base64enc::dataURI(file = "Tram-icon.png", mime = "image/png")
```

## Row {height="550px"}

### Column

```{r}
#| label: bus-journeys-by-year
plot_ly(bus_data,
        x = ~Year,
        y = ~Passengers_millions,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        line = list(color = accent_color, width = 3, shape = "spline"),
        marker = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 12,
                      line = list(color = accent_color, width = 3)),
        hovertext = ~paste0(Year, ": ", format(round(Passengers_millions, 1), nsmall = 1),
                             "M bus journeys"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "<b>Bus journeys by year</b>", font = title_font, x = 0),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#333333",
      bordercolor = "#333333",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = "",
                 tickvals = bus_data$Year,
                 tickformat = "d",
                 range = c(min(bus_data$Year) - 0.4, max(bus_data$Year) + 0.6),
                 showgrid = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Journeys (millions)",
                 titlefont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13, color = "#1a1a1a"),
                 range = c(0, 180),
                 showgrid = FALSE,
                 showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 13),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    margin = list(t = 40, r = 30),
    images = list(
      list(
        source = bus_icon,
        xref = "x",
        yref = "y",
        x = max(bus_data$Year) + 0.1,
        y = bus_data$Passengers_millions[which.max(bus_data$Year)],
        sizex = 0.35,
        sizey = 25,
        xanchor = "left",
        yanchor = "middle",
        layer = "above"
      )
    ),
    annotations = lapply(1:nrow(bus_data), function(i) {
      list(
        x = bus_data$Year[i],
        y = bus_data$Passengers_millions[i],
        text = paste0("<b>", format(round(bus_data$Passengers_millions[i], 1), nsmall = 1), "</b>"),
        showarrow = FALSE,
        yanchor = "bottom",
        yshift = 10,
        font = list(color = "#1a1a1a", size = 14, family = "Inter, sans-serif")
      )
    })
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
